notes: This is an explicit-route, proposal-only Codex Desktop skill. Positive cases name the skill and select either local Codex title review or ChatGPT web proposal. Generic history organization must not implicitly activate it. Both routes write linked Notion reports and never execute a rename, move, Project creation, merge, or archive.

Use $codex-thread-organizer for a proposal-only local Codex review with semantic type emoji, not status markers.

Rename this Git branch and clean up stale files
